nodes.description: address public owner; set in constructor to msg.sender and updated in transferOwnership.
address public ownerWallet; receives 5% fee transfers from buy().
uint256 public step = 2400; ROI rate constant used in getBalance.
uint256 public minimum = 10 finney; lower bound on msg.value in buy() and bounty payout threshold.
uint256 public maximum = 5 ether; upper bound on msg.value in buy().
uint256 public stakingRequirement = 0.5 ether; referral qualification threshold in buy().
mapping(address => uint256) investments; principal tracked per investor, read in getBalance/buy/checkInvestments.
mapping(address => uint256) joined; timestamp of last investment/withdraw, drives ROI accrual.
mapping(address => uint256) referrer; accrued referral bounty, credited in buy() and paid/zeroed in bounty().
constructor() public; assigns owner and ownerWallet from msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address,address) public onlyOwner; transfers contract control and payout wallet.
function () public payable; forwards value to buy(0x0).
buy(address) public payable; records investment, credits referrer, calls withdraw() when prior balance exists, transfers 5% fee to ownerWallet.
getBalance(address) view public; computes accrued ROI using block.timestamp and exponential multiplier.
withdraw() public; resets joined[msg.sender] then transfers computed balance to msg.sender.
bounty() public; reads referrer balance via checkReferral and pays it out to msg.sender.
checkBalance() public view; returns getBalance(msg.sender).
checkInvestments(address) public view; returns investments[_investor].
checkReferral(address) public view; returns referrer[_hunter].
library SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256); checked multiplication helper.
library SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256); division helper.
library SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256); asserted subtraction helper.
library SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256); asserted addition helper.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller used for auth, accounting keys and payout destinations.
block.timestamp / now: miner-influenced time source for ROI accrual and join times.
msg.sender.transfer(balance / address(this).balance) inside withdraw(); external Ether send to untrusted caller.
msg.sender.transfer(refBalance) inside bounty(); external Ether send to untrusted caller.
ownerWallet.transfer(msg.value.mul(5).div(100)) inside buy(); external fee send.
2**(minutesCount / 60) in getBalance(); unchecked exponentiation can overflow for long held positions.
Unchecked '* i' multiplication and '+=' accumulation of percent/balance in getBalance() loop.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter newOwnerWallet of transferOwnership.
Parameter _referredBy of buy(); address whose referral credit is increased.
Parameter _address of getBalance(); investor being priced.
Parameter _investor of checkInvestments.
Parameter _hunter of checkReferral.
Local _customerAddress = msg.sender inside buy().
Local minutesCount = now.sub(joined[_address]).div(1 minutes) inside getBalance().
Local userROIMultiplier = 2**(minutesCount/60) inside getBalance().
Local percent inside getBalance(); per-step ROI amount.
Local balance accumulated inside getBalance().
Local balance = getBalance(msg.sender) inside withdraw(); amount sent via transfer.
Local refBalance = checkReferral(msg.sender) inside bounty(); amount sent via transfer.
Loop counter i in getBalance(); doubled each iteration.

edges.reason: constructor assigns owner and ownerWallet directly from msg.sender, fixing privileged roles to the deployer.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before ownership can be transferred.
buy() derives _customerAddress from msg.sender and keys investments/joined on it.
withdraw() computes and transfers the payout for msg.sender, the untrusted caller.
bounty() reads referrer[msg.sender] and pays the caller.
buy() stores joined[msg.sender] = block.timestamp, making accounting miner-influenced.
getBalance() uses now.sub(joined[_address]) so ROI depends on block.timestamp.
withdraw() resets joined[msg.sender] = block.timestamp, gating future accrual on miner time.
withdraw() calls getBalance(msg.sender) to determine the payout amount.
withdraw() executes msg.sender.transfer(balance) before returning, an external call to the caller.
bounty() executes msg.sender.transfer(refBalance), an external Ether send to the caller.
buy() sends a 5% fee to ownerWallet via transfer().
buy() calls withdraw() for existing investors before updating investments[msg.sender].
bounty() calls checkReferral(msg.sender) to obtain the payout amount.
checkBalance() delegates to getBalance(msg.sender).
getBalance() computes 2**(minutesCount/60), an unchecked exponentiation that can overflow.
getBalance() performs raw * i multiplication and += accumulation without overflow guards.
getBalance() uses SafeMath.mul for investments*step and percent*60.
getBalance() uses SafeMath.div for /1000 and /1440 scaling.
buy() uses SafeMath.mul/div/add for referral credit and investment bookkeeping.
transfer() in withdraw() hands control to msg.sender, which may re-enter withdraw/bounty.
transfer() in bounty() hands control to msg.sender, enabling re-entrant bounty/withdraw.
constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership rewrites the owner state variable after the onlyOwner check.
transferOwnership reads owner to authorize the caller.
The fee transfer target is the ownerWallet state variable.
buy() enforces msg.value >= minimum.
buy() enforces msg.value <= maximum.
buy() compares investments[_referredBy] against stakingRequirement for referral eligibility.
getBalance() reads investments[_address] as the ROI principal.
getBalance() subtracts joined[_address] from now to derive elapsed time.
bounty() reads and zeroes referrer[msg.sender].

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only used by transferOwnership to set the owner state variable; fold into that function node.
newOwnerWallet is only used by transferOwnership to set ownerWallet; fold into that function node.
_referredBy is only consumed by buy() for the referral check and credit; fold into buy.
_address is only consumed by getBalance() for elapsed-time and principal lookups; fold into getBalance.
_investor is only consumed by checkInvestments() to index the investments mapping.
_hunter is only consumed by checkReferral() to index the referrer mapping.
_customerAddress is the local alias of msg.sender inside buy(); fold into buy.
minutesCount is a getBalance-local time delta derived from joined and now; fold into getBalance.
userROIMultiplier is the getBalance-local value computed by the unsafe exponentiation; fold into getBalance.
percent is a getBalance-local ROI amount feeding the unchecked arithmetic; fold into getBalance.
balance_getBalance is the getBalance-local accumulator returned to callers; fold into getBalance.
balance_withdraw is the withdraw-local amount passed to msg.sender.transfer; fold into that unsafe operation.
refBalance is the bounty-local amount passed to msg.sender.transfer; fold into that unsafe operation.
i is the getBalance loop counter that drives the unchecked multiplication; fold into getBalance.
